description: Removes tools previously added by activate_tools from the advertised list, shrinking the context cost back down. Pass names, a bundle to drop a task menu loaded with activate_tools, or all:true to return to exactly the configured profile. Emits tools/list_changed. Cannot remove a tool the configured profile itself advertises -- change PREMIERE_MCP_PROFILE for that.

all.description: Deactivate everything activate_tools added this session (default false)

bundle.description: Drop the tools a bundle activation added

names.description: Activated tool names to stop advertising

name: deactivate_tools
